main_text.l: ἐπινικόν [?] ἐστι, μάλιστα ἀγώνων continens laudē vel ψόγον.
Ἐνδόξων περὶ ἀγαθῶν ὁμολογι-μένων, ut virtutis ἢ ἄλλου τινὸς φανερᾶς ἀγαθοῦ.
2. Ὑπορχηματικός, à Bacchilide inuē [?] tus uterque
3. φυσικὸς, ut Empedocles describēs naturas deorum, ut Iupiter fit aër.
5. Γενεαλογικὸς poëtarum Theogoniæ musę [?] ex memoria.
Ἀθανάτων ὑμνῆς εἰς θεὺς [?]: Immortalium hymni in deos.

page.notes: Diagram page: the bracket structure is an approximation, read from the drawing, and the levels are estimates. Several Greek words are uncertain, especially the opening word of the root line, the "μάχων" in item 2, the Greek in the "Ἀθανάτων" box, and "musę". The Latin "Loco-rum Flumi-num Flu-uiorum" and the bracketed Latin of the Terrestrium/Volatilium/Reptilium boxes were read at low resolution. The footnote at the end is a translation I added; it is not printed on the page and should be removed. The page-foot "c iij" is the gathering signature.
